description: This file defines an interface for a Grain in Orleans that handles multiple stream subscriptions for testing purposes, including methods for becoming a consumer, resuming, stopping, retrieving subscriptions, and managing consumption counters.

classes.name: IMultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain
classes.description: Interface for a Grain that manages multiple stream subscriptions, providing methods to subscribe, resume, stop, and retrieve subscription details.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribe to a stream as a consumer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resume a previously paused or inactive subscription handle.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Stop consuming from a specific subscription handle.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieve all subscriptions associated with a stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Get the count of messages consumed per subscription handle.

methods.name: ClearNumberConsumed
methods.description: Reset the counters of messages consumed.
